description: List the audit log for a SWSD record. Each audit entry captures one change: action ("Update"/"Create"/"Delete"), message ("State changed from New to Assigned"), the user who performed it, and the timestamp. Use this to answer "who changed this ticket?" or "what happened since I last looked?". Cheaper than swsd_get_incident with detail_level=long when you only need the audit history. object_type accepts incidents, problems, changes, releases, solutions, hardwares, other_assets.

id.description: Record id. When object_type is "incidents" or "solutions", accepts either the internal id (>=7 digits) or the human-facing number (<=6 digits / <=4 digits respectively). Other object types require the internal id.

object_type.description: The SWSD record type to fetch audits for. Use 'incidents' for tickets, 'solutions' for KB articles, etc.

per_page.description: Audits per page (1-100). Older records may have hundreds of audit entries; default 25 is enough for "recent activity" reads.

name: swsd_get_record_audits

message.description: Human-readable change description, e.g. "State changed from New to On Hold".

note.description: Free-text note attached to the audit, often empty.

user.description: The user who performed the action (display name; user_id is separate).

uuid.description: Stable identifier for the audit row (SWSD assigns a UUID; no numeric id is exposed).

has_more.description: True when more pages exist beyond this one.

next_page.description: The next page number to request, when has_more is true.

per_page.description: Items per page used in the request.

total.description: Total record count when SWSD returns X-Total-Count.
